content.title: Insurer Stocks Fall on Medicare Rate Update
content.summary: Shares of insurance giants including UnitedHealth Group, Humana and CVS Health were hit hard late Monday after a report in The Wall Street Journal said the Trump administration was proposing roughly flat rates for Medicare insurers next year, an update that falls well short of Wall Street expectations.
